messages:
Marta: Quick design pass on the Roles panel toolbar in Org Settings — throwing this here before the review. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (frame: roles-toolbar-v3). Main asks: shorter action affordances, clearer SSO language, and audit-log discoverability.

Sam: Thanks — skimmed. Love the compactness but worried about discoverability for bulk actions. If we move to icon-first, can we add a persistent label on hover + keyboard hint? :thinking:

Jana: Agree with Sam. Also accessibility: when the 'Grant role' modal opens focus should land on the role dropdown, not the cancel button. Seen a11y test fail on that.

Mike: On SSO copy — current copy says `Require SSO for org` which some folks read as "turn SSO on" vs "mandatory for everyone". Two proposals: 1) `Enforce SSO sign-in for all members` 2) `Require SSO sign-in (disables password login)`. Prefer 1 for clarity.

Claire: +1 to Jana re: focus order. Also we need aria-labels on the toolbar buttons if we go icon-only. Example: `button aria-label=\"Invite members to org\"` and `button aria-label=\"Bulk invite via CSV\"`.

Frank: Audit log: the filter dropdown is currently below the fold on long orgs. Can we try a sticky filter row above the table like the mock? That makes time-based filters and actor search way easier. Also small UX nit: the timestamp format in the mock is `MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm` — can we switch to `YYYY-MM-DD` for clarity in international orgs?

Marta: Good notes. Proposed micro-changes for next iteration: - Keep full text on mobile+small width; icon-first on >1200px with tooltip and keyboard hint. - Switch SSO copy to `Enforce SSO sign-in for all members` and add a hover info: "This will prevent password-based login and require your IdP." - Move audit filters into a sticky header row and expose keyboard focus trap onto the filter inputs. - Fix focus order for Grant Role modal.

Sam: One more: when someone toggles SSO enforcement, we should surface a clear rollback path in the toast (e.g., "Undo" + link to remediation doc). People panic when they flip org-wide security flags.

Jana: Accessibility checklist for the PR: focus order, aria-labels, contrast check on toolbar icons (min 4.5:1), keyboard-only flows for invite and bulk CSV import. I can add the checklist to the PR template.

Mike: Copy tweak: replace "Grant" with "Assign" in a few places — "Assign role" reads clearer to non-admins. Thoughts?

Claire: "Assign" is fine. Also consider microcopy under the SSO toggle: small secondary text "Admins can still manage SSO settings in Security -> SSO" to avoid confusion about where to configure the IdP.

Frank: Re: audit nav keyboard shortcut idea: can we support `g a` to jump to Audit log? Would help power users. Not required for launch but worth tracking.

design-bot: NOTE: Added a11y annotations and updated prototype with sticky filter row (version roles-toolbar-v3a). See comment on frame for keyboard flows.

Marta: Thanks everyone. I'll update the mock with these changes and post a new link before EOD. If any of you want to pair on the a11y checklist, ping me. :thumbsup:
